instruction: Set custom prompts in SQLite shell
output: sqlite3 mydb.db ".prompt 'sqlite> ' '  ..> '"

instruction: Turn on headers and set column mode
output: sqlite3 mydb.db ".headers on" ".mode column"
sqlite3 mydb.db ".timer on" "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM large_table;"
sqlite3 mydb.db ".stats on" "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%test%';"
sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users';"
sqlite3 mydb.db "UPDATE orders SET status = 'archived' FROM users WHERE users.id = orders.user_id AND users.active = 0;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "DELETE FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE active = 0);"

instruction: Create a table with CHECK constraint
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "CREATE TABLE products (id INT, price REAL CHECK(price > 0));"

instruction: Create a table with default datetime
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, message TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')));"

instruction: Add a column to an existing table
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN phone TO mobile;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN old_field;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "ALTER TABLE users RENAME TO customers;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT id FROM users EXCEPT SELECT user_id FROM orders;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT user_id FROM orders INTERSECT SELECT id FROM users;"

instruction: Use UNION ALL to combine results
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT name FROM employees UNION ALL SELECT name FROM contractors;"

instruction: Use CASE expression in a SELECT
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT id, name, CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_active FROM users;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT id, COALESCE(phone, 'N/A') AS phone FROM users;"
sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT id, NULLIF(status, 'unknown') FROM users;"

instruction: Use GLOB for file-glob pattern matching
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT * FROM files WHERE name GLOB '*.txt';"

instruction: Create a table with STRICT typing
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "CREATE TABLE strict_table (id INT, name TEXT) STRICT;"

instruction: Execute multiple queries in one call
output: sqlite3 mydb.db "SELECT 1; SELECT 2; SELECT 3;"
